description: Docs gap: PATCH /workers/dispatch/namespaces/{dispatch_namespace}/scripts/{script_name}/settings requires multipart/form-data with the settings JSON as a `settings` form part, like the account-level script settings PATCH (workers/patchScriptScriptAndVersionSetting.manual.json). A live call on 2026-10-09 sent as JSON was rejected with `Content-Type must be one of: multipart/form-data`.
